notes.title: Custom World maps are here!
notes.notes:
Hey On a Roll fans!

There is a new update available which features the ability to load your own custom built maps. You can now build your own levels right inside of the Unity Engine and play them in the game.

All info can be found in the installation folder of your game.

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE (Optimization, gameplay improvements etc.)
notes.notes:
[h1]
Hey hey extreme sporters!

Finally a new UPDATE! Thanks for your patience. 
[b]NOTE: MAKE SURE TO CHECK THE INTEGRITY OF YOUR LOCAL FILES. You can do this by right clicking On a Roll in your Steam library and then navigating to the LOCAL FILES tab. Then simply click 'VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME FILES...' and wait for it to finish.
[/b]
Here are some of the things you can expect in the new update:
[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Inverse Kinematics to the avatars feet, this system makes sure that the feet always nicely align to the surface and also prevents the feet from sinking through the ground.
[*]You can now skate over low obstacles such as curbs and low ledges without bumping into them or without the need to jump.
[*]The avatar now turns its head slightly whenever you turn the camera (only while standing still)
[*]2 NEW droppable object added.
[*]Changed Cess slide input: instead of tapping the cess slide input once, players are now required to hold the input for as long as they wish to keep up the trick.
[*]Optimisation: Far less in-game loading hiccups, although there is still an occasional stutter.
[*]Improved reaction time for reversing (L1/R1), should feel a lot more responsive now.
[*]Pumping on quarterpipes no longer requires you to release the acceleration button, you can just keep holding while rolling up and the avatar will give it his maximum push.
[*]Lots of previously un-grindable rails are now grindable.
[*]these are the major improvements, there's a bunch more small tech stuff which has improved as well.
[*]Added support for NVIDIA Ansel which enables players to create up to 64K screenshots etc..
[/list]

That's it for now, hope you enjoy!
Cheers!
Jelle

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
Ready for a new update?! Here we go:

[*]Level loading optimization
[*]Slower (none-prewind) grind inspins for more control over alleyoop tricks
[*]Several smaller benches are now grindable whereas they weren't before
[*]Additions of some small new spots near the Info Center and the Waterpark entrance etc.
[*]The entire world is now open for exploration, but keep in mind that several new areas are still very much a work in progress
[*]Added warning message to indicate 'work in progress' areas.
[*]Improved ability to grind rails close to a wall, but keep in mind that some rails are in fact too close so weird glitches are still possible. No worries though, these rails will be modified for better functionality.

notes.title: UPDATE: Character Editor
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Ready for a new update?!

[list]
[*]The [b]Character Editor[/b] is now operational. Create your own avatar and decide what he's wearing.
[*]More custom items will be added to the in-game store as things evolve.
[*]You can access character customization from within the game by going to the mall or via the menu by selecting 'character'.
[*]That's it for this update. Next update I'm tackling the environments.
[/list]

Enjoy everyone!
Cheers Jelle

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
What's up everyone! Just wanted to announce a small Halloween update. The update contains the following:
[list]
[*]major grinding improvement: your avatars feet are now perfectly following the curvature of the rail even while grinding through kinked or curved rails making grinding look a lot smoother.
[*]Added a new character called 'bones' to celebrate our Halloween sale!
[/list]

[i]NOTE: I'm working on much bigger things as well, such as extending and optimizing the game's environments so far I've been able to achieve a significant increase in framerate. However, because there's still quite a bit of work to be done in these areas, I decided to not yet include this in the current update.
Obviously there will be a lot more bug fixes as well in the upcoming weeks.
[/i]


Thanks for your continued support and have a scary Halloween :)!

notes.title: UPDATE: infinite loading screen fix and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! There was a bug which caused the game to get stuck at an infinite loading screen if the player selected ‘CANCEL’ from the character selection menu. This issue has now been addressed. 

[i]NOTE: Keep in mind that if your system specs do not meet the minimum requirements listed at our store page (especially your graphics card + RAM), the game could still get stuck during loading. This is simply because your computer does not have sufficient RAM or video RAM to successfully load all graphical assets into its memory.[/i]

[h1][b]minor changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added controls reference PDF to installation folder as well as to the in-game menu under settings.
[*]Added Grinds menu to the in-game menu. This menu provides an overview of all currently available grinds + their respective input combinations.
[/list]

Once again thank you so much for all of your support, feedback and patience with me. I’m just a one-man team so occasionally it can take some time for me to respond or fix things, but please know that I have the best intentions of making this game as amazing as I possibly can.

[h1][b]Interesting links:[/b][/h1]
The On a Roll community has been super active and passionate lately. People have taken it upon themselves to start all sorts of community pages and groups, here are some of the ones I found out about, though there may be many more (If so don’t hesitate to let me know). Feel free to check them out:

[list]
[*][b]Discord:[/b] https://discordapp.com/channels/352450214574948353/354667142794444810
[*][b]Forum:[/b] http://onaroll-studio.proboards.com
[*][b]Facebook Feedback Group:[/b] https://www.facebook.com/groups/onarollgroup/
[/list]

A big thank you goes out to the people responsible for settings up these pages / communities
